PROVED (namespace S1745.FiniteEtaleClosure, K : Type [Field K] implicit):
1. instance : (CommAlgCat.finiteEtale K : ObjectProperty (CommAlgCat.{0} K)).IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms
   (needed for ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderLimitsOfShape.mk' / IsClosedUnderColimitsOfShape.mk';
    Module.Finite via CommAlgCat.algEquivOfIso + Module.Finite.equiv, Etale via Algebra.Etale.of_equiv).
2. piFan / piFan_isLimit: point CommAlgCat.of K (forall j, A j), projections Pi.evalAlgHom K A j,
   lift = CommAlgCat.ofHom (AlgHom.pi ...); IsLimit proved by hand (fac/uniq).
3. EXACTLY THE REQUESTED: instance isClosedUnderLimitsOfShape_discrete (J : Type) [Fintype J] :
   (CommAlgCat.finiteEtale K).IsClosedUnderLimitsOfShape (Discrete J)
   via mk' + strictLimitsOfShape: transport limit F to limit (Discrete.functor (F.obj o mk))
   (Discrete.natIsoFunctor, HasLimit.isoOfNatIso) then to the Pi fan (conePointUniqueUpToIso);
   the Pi point is finite etale by Module.Finite.pi / Algebra.Etale pi instance (S1739 finite_pi/etale_pi).
4. tensorCocone / tensorCocone_isColimit: for f : A --> B, g : A --> C in CommAlgCat K, the pushout
   cocone with point CommAlgCat.of K (B (x)_A C), inl = includeLeft : B -->_K B(x)_A C,
   inr = (includeRight).restrictScalars K : C -->_K B(x)_A C, coherence = algebraMap_apply/algebraMap_apply'.
   IsColimit: desc s := (Algebra.pushoutDesc (B(x)_A C) f' g' (mul_comm ...)).restrictScalars K with
   Algebra A s.pt := (s.inl.hom.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap A B)).toAlgebra (plus IsScalarTower K A s.pt);
   uniqueness from Algebra.IsPushout.algHom_ext (S' := B(x)_A C). Uses Algebra.IsPushout/TensorProduct.isPushout,
   Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra + right_isScalarTower.
5. finiteEtale_tensorCocone_pt: B(x)_A C is finite etale over K.
   finite: Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite K A B/C, Module.Finite.tensorProduct A B C, Module.Finite.trans A.
   etale: Algebra.Etale.of_restrictScalars K A C => Etale A C; Etale.baseChange A C B => Etale B (B(x)_A C);
   Algebra.Etale.comp K B (B(x)_A C).
6. instance isClosedUnderColimitsOfShape_walkingSpan :
   (CommAlgCat.finiteEtale K).IsClosedUnderColimitsOfShape WalkingSpan
   via mk' + diagramIsoSpan + IsColimit.precomposeHomEquiv + colimit.isoColimitCocone.
7. ASSEMBLY: hasFiniteProducts (CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale K); hasColimitsOfShape WalkingSpan (CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale K);
   instance hasFiniteCoproducts : HasFiniteCoproducts ((CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.{0} K)^op)
   (via hasColimitsOfShape_op_of_hasLimitsOfShape (J := Discrete (Fin n)) and Discrete.opposite (Fin n));
   instance hasPullbacks : HasPullbacks ((CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.{0} K)^op)
   (via HasColimitsOfShape WalkingCospan^op from walkingCospanOpEquiv + hasLimitsOfShape_op_of_hasColimitsOfShape).

AXIOM AUDIT (all 9 #print axioms at end of file): only [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. No sorryAx.

IMPORTANT SHAPE CORRECTION (documented in section 5 of the file): the task asked for
IsClosedUnderColimitsOfShape WalkingCospan, but that is NOT the instance pullbacks need.
Mathlib: HasPullbacks C := HasLimitsOfShape WalkingCospan C. For C = (FiniteEtale K)^op we need
HasLimitsOfShape WalkingCospan (FiniteEtale K)^op, i.e. HasColimitsOfShape WalkingCospan^op (FiniteEtale K),
and WalkingCospan^op ~= WalkingSpan (walkingCospanOpEquiv) => HasPushouts (FiniteEtale K).
So the required closure is IsClosedUnderColimitsOfShape WalkingSpan (pushouts), which is what item 6 proves.
(A WalkingCospan-shaped diagram is a cospan B --> A <-- C and its colimit is just the apex A, since the shape
has a terminal object; that instance would be a triviality, is not needed, and is not asserted as an instance.)

((CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.{0} K)^op) and can be replaced by `inferInstance` once this file is imported/compiled
in the same package (no statement change, no new hypotheses). Remaining 4 GaloisCategory fields unaffected.
